posts.title: Summer is the busiest time of year for most electrical networks, and many… | Ampcontrol
posts.copy: Summer is the busiest time of year for most electrical networks, and many sites see their transformer loads rise with it. More load means more heat inside the transformer, which puts more stress on any issue that's already developing. An oil sample is one of the simplest ways to find out where your transformers stand before that happens. It's taken while the transformer is running, so there's no outage or lost production. Our new article covers why summer load matters, what an oil test shows and how our team can take samples for you 👉 https://bit.ly/4yYnNDX
